description: This file defines the EmployeeEventDao class in the OrangeHRM system, responsible for data access operations related to EmployeeEvent entities, including saving and retrieving events with filtering and pagination.

classes.name: EmployeeEventDao
classes.description: Data Access Object class for handling EmployeeEvent entities, including saving events and retrieving filtered/paginated lists.

methods.name: saveEmployeeEvent
methods.description: Persists an EmployeeEvent entity to the database and returns it.

methods.name: getEmployeeEvents
methods.description: Retrieves a list of EmployeeEvent entities based on provided filter parameters with pagination.

methods.name: getEmployeeEventPaginator
methods.description: Constructs and returns a paginator object for EmployeeEvent entities based on filter parameters and optional date range, event, type, and employee number filters.
